facts.summary: Rosacea trial missed primary endpoints · Phase 2 · DMT310 in moderate-to-severe rosacea · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Data supportive of DMT310 as a treatment for inflammatory skin diseases, but rosacea study did not meet primary endpoints
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Data supportive of DMT310 as a treatment for inflammatory skin diseases, but rosacea study did not meet primary endpoints
evidence.safety: DMT310 produced no serious adverse events related to treatment
evidence.program_discontinued: We will continue to evaluate the full data set to determine DMT310’s potential as a treatment for moderate-to-severe rosacea.
